description: Update an existing initiative — only the fields you provide change. Use to rename, re-prioritise, retarget, adjust the token budget, move it under a program, set its owning team (teamId), record the team's own estimate (estimate), or set its repositories (defaultGithubRepo, additionalGithubRepos) and branch. An argument this tool does not declare is refused with the valid names and nothing is changed, so a success means every field you passed was applied. Requires `write` scope. (System-managed initiatives are read-only and reject edits.)

additionalGithubRepos.description: Further repositories ("owner/name") this initiative's work items may modify, beside defaultGithubRepo — so an item can set targetGithubRepo to one of them. Replaces the list; [] clears it. Removing a repository is refused while a work item still targets it.

assignedOperatorId.description: New operator (DRI) — a member uid or their email (anyforge_list_members lists both). Must be an approved editor-or-above member. Can be changed after the initiative is COMPLETE, without reopening it.

autoDispatchOnApproval.description: Start a crew on each READY work item as soon as the backlog is approved, instead of dispatching each by hand.

autoMergeOnApproval.description: Default for "Auto-merge PR on GitHub after approval" on this initiative's ship gates. Approving a gate still decides; this only pre-sets the choice. Overrides the program and company default.

confirmDeclassify.description: Moving an initiative out of a PRIVATE program makes it and its work visible to everyone who can see where it goes, so the change is refused with 409 declassification_unconfirmed until confirmed. Send true ONLY after the person has explicitly said yes to that, never on your own judgement.

contextNotes.description: Intake notes: context the architect reads until the initiative has a spec (refused on update once a spec exists — edit the spec instead).

decompositionStrategy.description: Backlog shape for the next Architect run.

defaultCrewType.description: The crew type this initiative's dispatches use when the caller names none; it outranks the work item's type.

defaultGithubBranch.description: Base branch the crews build on. Omit to inherit the repository's own default branch — there is no hard-coded "main" guess. A value you supply is checked against the remote and the real default is used if it does not exist there.

description.description: Updated intent (what needs to be done).

estimate.description: The team's own estimate as a person says it — "5d", "3w", "1m", or a number of days. Stored as teamEstimateDays, beside the system's estimate; null or "" clears it.

longLived.description: Ongoing delivery stream (skips the terminal integration-validation item).

operatorPlanned.description: Bounded work the operator plans themselves: no architect run, no plan to approve. Setting it true moves a DRAFT initiative to IN_PROGRESS so its work can be filed and dispatched; it is refused while a proposed plan awaits approval (decide that plan first) and on a long-lived initiative. Setting it false hands planning back to the Architect.

programId.description: Parent program id; null unlinks from its program.

prsLeftForHumanReview.description: People review and merge this initiative's pull requests; AnyForge never merges them. When true: no integration-validation work item is created (an existing one is dropped, and restored when set back to false); closing needs each crew-built item's pull request on record and approved at the ship gate instead of merged; and auto-merge, Autopilot and release-health approvals approve without merging, whatever autoMergeOnApproval says. Default false.

status.description: DRAFT | BACKLOG_PROPOSED | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETE | ARCHIVED. COMPLETE records today as the close date (what delivery reports and time recording read); moving off COMPLETE clears it.

taskTracker.description: People deliver this initiative and AnyForge only tracks it: work items are worked by hand and no crew ever runs under it. Setting it true also makes bounded work operatorPlanned (and moves a DRAFT initiative live); operatorPlanned cannot be set false while it is on. Setting it false lets crews build the work again.

teamId.description: The owning team, by slug (an existing team in this workspace; "default" hands the initiative back to the unowned team). It cannot be cleared, and an unknown slug is refused.

name: anyforge_update_initiative
title: Update initiative
